source_topology.latency_policy: Only compare source publication latency when both source-native timestamps are MINUTE precision; otherwise LATENCY_UNKNOWN.

migration.policy: Medical product development continues here; Hermes keeps integration architecture only.

critical_rules: Lifecycle type comes from official notice title, not project name.
Verified termination supersedes older verified tender for the same canonical project when chronology is source-evidenced.
Unverified newer events cannot override verified lifecycle state.
Month-only procurement intent dates must preserve month precision.
DAY-only publication dates must not be treated as true midnight timestamps.
Same-day conflicting lifecycle events with insufficient timestamp precision must be CONFLICTED instead of guessed into an order.
Exact project_number links PRIMARY and mirror evidence to one canonical opportunity.
Same-state same-day evidence prefers PRIMARY_SOURCE when exact chronology is unavailable.
Award item facts require original official evidence section.
Customer profile missing conditions block high-confidence personalized recommendation.
Coverage remains PARTIAL while any required P0 source is only PARTIAL_IMPLEMENTATION.
